description: This file contains code for computing centers of polyhedra, including Chebyshev center, maximum volume inscribed ellipsoid center, and analytic center, using convex optimization with cvxopt library. It also includes visualization code with pylab.

methods.name: F
methods.description: Defines the convex optimization problem for maximum volume inscribed ellipsoid and analytic center, returning function value, gradient, and Hessian.
